title: Does quantizing an open model break its safety concept directions?

original_idea.body: Extract safety concept vectors at full precision, then re-extract on 8-bit and 4-bit quantized versions and compare cosine similarity, probe AUC, and steering efficacy across precisions.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: quantization breaking safety directions affects non-lab deployments, but link has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract at full/8-bit/4-bit and compare; standard tooling, accessible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Consumer-GPU robustness irrelevant to full-precision labs, open models.

novelty.reasoning: Quantization effects on safety concept directions appear largely untested.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A fresh angle on quantization and safety directions.
